title: High-quality RNA purification with on-column DNase treatment from tissue specimens
author: Magda Bletsa
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8ufhwtn

steps.title: Add RLT Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL RLT Buffer to each Precellys lysate tube (Precellys CK28 Lysing Kit Hard Tissue Homogenizing, Bertin VWR International (Avantor), Catalog #10144-516).

steps.title: Add tissue sample
steps.instruction: Excise a lentil‑sized piece of tissue (maximum 20 mg for RNAlater‑stabilized tissue or 30 mg for fresh/frozen tissue) and transfer it quickly to the lysate tubes, ensuring the tissue is fully immersed in the RLT reagent.

steps.title: Homogenize tissue
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on dry ice for 2 min (or until frozen) and then thaw quickly. Immediately homogenize the thawed lysate with a Minilys rotor‑stator homogeniser (Bertin Instruments, model P000673‑MLYS0‑A) at medium speed (≈4000 rpm) for 2 min. Check the lysate; if visible tissue fragments remain, repeat the freeze‑thaw and homogenisation cycle until the lysate appears clear.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate for 3 min at full speed. Carefully pipette off the supernatant and transfer it to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL 70 % ethanol to the supernatant and mix immediately by pipetting up and down five times. Do not vortex or centrifuge.

steps.title: Bind RNA to column
steps.instruction: Transfer 700 µL of the mixture to an RNeasy spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube. Centrifuge for 30 s at 10 000 rpm. If the sample volume exceeds 700 µL, replace the collection tube, transfer the remaining lysate to the same column, and centrifuge again. Discard used collection tubes and replace with fresh ones.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer RW1
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL Buffer RW1 to the spin column, centrifuge for 30 s at 10 000 rpm, and change the collection tube.

steps.title: Prepare DNase master mix
steps.instruction: For each sample, combine 10 µL DNase I stock solution with 70 µL Buffer RDD. Mix gently by inverting the tube, spin down briefly, and do not vortex.

steps.title: DNase incubation
steps.instruction: Add the 80 µL DNase I incubation mix directly onto the spin‑column membrane and incubate at room temperature for 15 min on the benchtop.

steps.title: Post‑DNase wash
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL Buffer RW1 to the spin column, centrifuge for 30 s at 10 000 rpm, and replace the collection tube.

steps.title: First RPE wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer RPE to the spin column, centrifuge for 30 s at 10 000 rpm, and change the collection tube.

steps.title: Second RPE wash
steps.instruction: Add another 500 µL Buffer RPE to the spin column, centrifuge for 2 min at 10 000 rpm, and change the collection tube.

steps.title: Dry spin column
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a fresh collection tube and centrifuge at full speed for 5 min. If liquid still passes through, replace the collection tube and centrifuge for an additional 1 min.

steps.title: First RNA elution
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, add 50 µL RNase‑free water directly onto the membrane, incubate at room temperature for 5 min, then centrifuge for 1 min at 10 000 rpm to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Second RNA elution
steps.instruction: Repeat the elution step using a new 1.5 mL tube and another 50 µL of RNase‑free water.

steps.title: Store RNA and column
steps.instruction: Store the eluted RNA at –20 °C. Optionally, place the spin column back into its collection tube and store at –20 °C for future elutions (up to a third or fourth elution may still recover additional RNA).
